svg.title: Payment Component Architecture - Smart-Contract Pattern (Contract-First | Event-Driven | Multi-Channel | Provider-Agnostic | AI-Ready)

g.text: Provider contract ID → Our contract ID
1. Find contract by provider order ID
Order created only when safe (all conditions met)
+50ms overhead, but worth it for cleaner architecture
Explicit contract states, simpler order states
Add new conditions without code changes
